releases.title: Ethiopia journey dataset draft
releases.lead: The explorer now focuses on Ethiopia business and individual public-service journeys, with draft process maps that are still under verification.

changes.title: 27 Ethiopia journeys.
changes.body: The dataset includes 11 business journeys and 16 individual public-service journeys.

changes.title: Business and individual audience filters.
changes.body: The homepage can show all journeys, business journeys, or individual public-service journeys.

changes.title: Draft verification workflow.
changes.body: The contact form invites corrections about missing steps, wrong office names, documents, fees, processing time, and office-specific differences.

changes.title: Methodology reframed.
changes.body: This page explains that journeys are illustrative, user-centered, and not legal advice.

releases.title: Dependency-aware journeys
releases.lead: Journey steps are sequenced by practical dependencies from the user's point of view.

changes.title: Smarter step ordering.
changes.body: Steps appear in the order an applicant is likely to encounter them, even when they cross different offices or service providers.

changes.title: Dependency View.
changes.body: A toggle shows how steps connect, including hard dependencies, soft dependencies, and steps that may run in parallel.

changes.title: Mobile-ready.
changes.body: The journey page works on phones with a phase-by-phase accordion and compact timeline.

releases.title: Initial explorer
releases.lead: The first version established the journey matrix, step details, search, and filters.

changes.title: Journey matrix view.
changes.body: Each journey renders as a phased map of offices, requirements, and process steps.

changes.title: Search and filter.
changes.body: Users can find a journey by name or narrow the list by audience, jurisdiction, and category.

changes.title: Step details.
changes.body: Tap any step to see agency, fee, processing time, renewal term, and other available metadata.
